limitations: This acceptance covers only the four CheckTag criteria in the light/default/zh-CN/ltr/reduced-motion, focused unchecked checkpoint. It is not package, full a11y, performance-gate, or CI acceptance.
Bounds prove the three recorded checkpoints, not an absence of instantaneous movement between them. Per-operation browser durations are not a shared cross-platform timeline.
AT-SPI exposes Check tag as enabled, focusable, shown/visible, checkable and unchecked, but not focused in this probe. Focus comes from CDP and Avalonia AutomationPeer.
Orca registration/reachability and PID are not recordings of spoken output; NVDA/VoiceOver were not tested. PNG and browser product do not independently prove sandbox state.
The Markdown-specific editableName diagnostic is false in both captures; no blanket accessibility pass is claimed. Lifetime observation is specific to this probe.
